name: Aso-Kuju National Park
nameJa: 阿蘇くじゅう国立公園
aliases: 阿蘇くじゅう国立公園
description: National park (1934) of the Aso caldera — one of the world's largest — with its active Nakadake crater, the green Kusasenri meadows, and the Kuju highlands.
notes: Designated 1934 (73,017 ha). Crater access closes with gas alerts; the caldera viewpoints are always open.
parking: Parking available at major visitor areas (fee varies)
